title: Senior Product Manager - Generative AI & API Platforms
jd_excerpt:
Amazon Alexa Ambient Computing team seeks a Senior Product Manager to define technical product requirements and drive development with engineering and partner teams. The role centers on Generative AI, APIs, and scalable data-driven features for customers and developers.

The ideal candidate has 5+ years in product/program management, end-to-end delivery experience, and can influence engineering decisions. This on-site Sunnyvale role offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits
